text:
Jordan Miles: Quick ping — planning a 'Coffee & Kudos' rolling cart next Fri (4/8) during peak hours 10:30-1:30. Need 3 award mini-trophies, 50 reusable mugs (branded), single-serve coffee pods, signage, and a small tablet to take digital nominations. Budget approved $800. Who can handle vendor pickup and tablet loan?
Kari Singh: I can grab mugs and pods Wed afternoon from VendorSupply (loading dock). I have a car. What's the pickup window?
Jordan Miles: Thanks @Kari — vendor says Wed 2-4pm. Package ID CS-442. Bring a dolly if possible.
Evan Brooks: I can loan the office iPad for the tablet check-in. Will need it back by 3pm Friday. Will charge before pickup.
Maya Chen: I'll order 3 mini-trophies and 50 sticker badges today. ETA 2 business days. Also can design a one-line sign: "Coffee & Kudos — nominate a teammate for a mini-spot award!" Want it printed small A3.
Jordan Miles: Perfect. Can someone create a short nomination form that takes: recipient name, one-sentence why, manager approval (checkbox), and opt-in to public recognition? Keep it 3 fields + checkbox.
Evan Brooks: I'll make a simple Google form and share link. Can we also have a QR code printed on the sign so people can nominate without the tablet?
Kari Singh: Good idea. I'll add a QR sticker sheet to the pickup. Also — does anyone have the expense code for pop-up supplies?
OpsBot: Reminder: Expense policy for pop-ups: submit within 7 days using code POPUP-CULTURE-2026. Receipts required. Link: https://redwood.internal/expenses. Approvers: People Ops or your manager.
Maya Chen: Volunteers: setup 9:45-10:30 (cart assembly), shift 10:30-12:00, shift 12:00-13:30, teardown 13:30-14:00. Who can cover teardown?
Jordan Miles: I can do teardown. Need one more person for midday shift 12-1.
Evan Brooks: I can cover 12-1.
Kari Singh: I'll pick up Wed 2:15pm and upload receipt. My phone for vendor calls: 555-0142.
Jordan Miles: Thanks — I'll create the calendar event and attach the Google form + printing checklist. Please RSVP so we know volunteer headcount. Will post reminder Fri 8:00am. :coffee: :trophy:
Maya Chen: Added sign mockup to the event and QR code. Also added a note about inclusive language for nominations (template in event).
Jordan Miles: One more note: trophies are small, $8 each. If we go over budget, we'll swap to enamel pins. OpsBot — can you add an automated reminder to volunteers 24 hours prior?
OpsBot: Reminder set: calendar notification 24 hours before event and expense reminder 7 days after pickup.
Kari Singh: All set on my end. See you Friday! :raised_hands:
